description: Implementation of an IAMF audio decoder class for handling audio decoding, configuration, and error reporting within the starboard shared libiamf namespace.

classes.name: IamfAudioDecoder
classes.description: A class responsible for decoding IAMF audio streams, managing decoder state, configuration, and error handling.

classes.name: DecodedAudio
classes.description: A nested class representing decoded audio data, including sample format and timestamp.

methods.name: IamfAudioDecoder
methods.description: Constructor initializing the decoder with audio stream info.

methods.name: ~IamfAudioDecoder
methods.description: Destructor that tears down the decoder.

methods.name: is_valid
methods.description: Checks if the decoder instance is valid.

methods.name: Initialize
methods.description: Sets up output and error callback functions.

methods.name: Decode
methods.description: Decodes input buffers and schedules output callback.

methods.name: DecodeInternal
methods.description: Performs internal decoding of a single input buffer.

methods.name: WriteEndOfStream
methods.description: Signals end of stream and pushes EOS marker.

methods.name: ConfigureDecoder
methods.description: Configures the decoder with buffer info and timestamp.

methods.name: Read
methods.description: Retrieves decoded audio data and sample rate.

methods.name: Reset
methods.description: Resets the decoder to initial state.

methods.name: GetSampleType
methods.description: Returns the sample type used for decoding.

methods.name: ReportError
methods.description: Logs and reports an error message.
